_comment: Intake screens applied by scripts/screen.py. Companies for the contact-center screen live in data/exclusions.md (company-level passes); this file holds the role-level keyword and title rules. Edit here, not in prose.

seniority._comment: Discard = create no row. Flag = keep the row but mark for a human glance (documented false-positive classes: bank pay-grade VP, department names containing a rank word, defense-contractor '(Director)' suffix). Tier-drop = keep, score 5-8 lower.

contact_center._comment: Hard screen added 2026-09-02 by the candidate. Role-level keywords; matches on title (and on the snippet/notes text when provided). Overrides the VoIP/Collab familiar-domains allowance.

age_out._comment: Standing-queue lifecycle policy read by scripts/age_out.py, not the intake screen above. Added 2026-09-10 when the one-off hybrid pass (runs/2026-09-10/ageout_hybrid_result.json) was productized into funnel-review step 5.
